problem.title: CT-ICP KITTI Odom seq 05 full: upstream mechanics with and without the elevation correction
problem.question: Does the CT-ICP pipeline that follows upstream jedeschaud/ct_icp with its driving profile (--ct-icp-upstream-mechanics) reproduce the paper's KITTI-corrected Table I values?

variants.label: upstream CT-ICP pipeline (driving profile) on raw scans
variants.intent: The upstream jedeschaud/ct_icp pipeline with config/odometry/driving_config.yaml (papers/ct_icp/README.md).

variants.label: upstream mechanics + KITTI 0.205 deg elevation correction
variants.intent: Same pipeline on KITTI-corrected scans (+0.205 deg HDL-64E elevation), as upstream's KITTI loader and the paper's Table I.
